sections.what_happened: Consolidated Oct 24-25 toll in Ukraine: Russian attacks killed 8 and injured 51 across Ukraine over the past day (Kyiv Independent, local authorities), including a drone strike on a five-storey residential building in Vinnytsia injuring 6 and destroying 4 apartments. Zelenskyy said Russia launched ~1,600 guided aerial bombs, 48 missiles and nearly 2,300 drones at Ukraine over the past week; in Dnipropetrovsk, 4 killed and 22 injured (incl. an 11-year-old girl); in Kharkiv, Russian forces struck a home-improvement store then carried out a follow-up strike on arriving emergency crews, injuring responders. In Russia, Ukrainian attacks killed 5 in total per consolidated regional reports (2 in a Bryansk minibus attack, 2 in Belgorod city + 1 near Shebekino) with 14+ injured in Belgorod region and 30 apartment blocks damaged; Russia's Defence Ministry claims 532 Ukrainian drones intercepted overnight. Ukraine's General Staff also reports strikes on radar stations near Hostyshcheve and Kurhanne (Belgorod region) and command posts in Zaporizhzhia/Kherson on Oct 24-25.
sections.what_verified: Kyiv Independent (T2) + Anadolu via anews (T3, STATE TR) + Zelenskyy primary statement + Ukrainian Air Force figures via LB.ua; Russian casualty figures vary by outlet and the Defence Ministry intercept claim is unattributed to independent verification.
sections.what_disputed: Russian casualty counts conflict across early reports (anews: 1 killed in Belgorod city; Reuters via Indian Express/AnewZ: 2 killed in Belgorod city + 1 near Shebekino = 3 in the region); Russia denies deliberately targeting civilian infrastructure. The 532-drone intercept claim and the Chornomorsk cargo-vessel claim (1400-01) remain Russian-ministry claims without independent confirmation.
sections.why_matters: The week in one number: 1,600 bombs, 48 missiles, 2,300 drones -- and the double-tap on Kharkiv rescuers as the war's rule-breaking signature.
